en.headline: John Lee officiates at ceremony for 160th anniversary of Sun Yat-sen birth
en.dek: The government held the official commemoration at Sun Yat Sen Memorial Park this morning, with senior officials and central government representatives in attendance.
body: Chief Executive John Lee officiated at the official ceremony this morning at Sun Yat Sen Memorial Park to mark the 160th anniversary of the birth of Dr Sun Yat-sen.

In his speech, Lee recalled Sun's connections with Hong Kong, where he studied at the Diocesan Home and Orphanage, Central School and the Hong Kong College of Medicine, the forerunner of the University of Hong Kong's Faculty of Medicine. He described Hong Kong as both the birthplace of Sun's revolutionary ideas and a base for planning uprisings.

Lee said the best way to commemorate Sun was to inherit his spirit of revitalising China and his patriotism, and to translate love for the country and Hong Kong into concrete action. The ceremony included a performance by the Police Band and singing of the national anthem.

The event was attended by senior government officials, representatives of central government organisations in Hong Kong, members of the Executive Council and Legislative Council, and other community representatives. No public viewing area was set up.

zh.headline: 李家超主禮孫中山先生誕辰160周年紀念儀式
zh.dek: 政府今早在中山紀念公園舉行官方紀念儀式，行政長官李家超主持並致辭，多名高層官員及中央駐港機構代表出席。
body: 行政長官李家超今早在中山紀念公園主持孫中山先生誕辰160周年紀念儀式並致辭。
李家超在致辭中回顧孫中山與香港的深厚淵源，指他早年在拔萃書室、中央書院及香港西醫書院（香港大學醫學院前身）就讀，香港既是其革命思想的緣起之地，也是策劃起義的重要基地。
他表示，紀念孫中山的最佳方式是學習其振興中華的志向及熱愛祖國的精神，將愛國愛港化為實際行動。儀式包括警察樂隊奏樂及合唱團獻唱國歌。
出席儀式的還有政府高層官員、中央人民政府駐港機構代表、行政會議成員、立法會議員及社會各界人士。現場不設公眾觀禮區。
